The quotation is accurate: 'b. From its identification with the finite verb or the infinitive, and its consequent misuse as an independent finite verb or even its co-ordination to them by means of καί (1720)'. summary:
I checked all 46 findings by R2 for places 08-13. Result: 41 confirmed, 4 corrected, 1 could not open. None is wrong or not found.

Corrections:
(1) Place 08 #0: P fr. 1 has the simplex λαβὼν at 26.24 (Vinc. 338.22), not μεταλαβών. The μετειληφὼς point itself stands.
(2) Place 11 #1: Vinc. 342.14 'τοῦ μήκους τῶν χορδῶν' is not P fr. 2. It opens fr. 3, and Vincent says that paragraph is taken from the 1545 edition. P's χορδῶν is at 342.5-6. The author also uses νευρά for 'string' (Bas. 26.4, fr. 1 at 338.8, fr. 3 at 342.21).
(3) Place 12 #4: 'τελειοτάτης καταπυκνώσεως τῆς διὰ πασῶν' is in Nicomachus Harm. ench. ch. 11 (Jan p. 260), not ch. 12.
(4) Place 12 #8: West 1973 could not be opened. A secondary source places assimilation to a nearby word at p. 24.

Points worth noting among the confirmed:
- Jannaris §740 says the perfect participle in particular dropped reduplication, which the place 08 #8 finding leaves out.
- Jannaris §2168b is about the circumstantial participle used as a finite verb in vulgar texts, not about omitted copulas.
- The Aristotle Probl. 15.3 range should be b23-32, not b23-31.

Method: Perseus refused WebFetch and curl, so I opened it in the browser pane (morphology tool, corpus searches, John 19:28) and took Smyth from CCEL and Alpheios. The archive.org findings I checked against the OCR text, and against the page images for Jan p. 239, Hoche p. 115 and Bekker p. 910. The Kriaras site returned 403.

Downloads are in work-v.
